description: Issue #862: EtlLineageRecord now implements ITenant with a new TenantCode column. This mutant deletes the ApplyEtlTenantFilter<EtlLineageRecord>(builder, context) call in ApplyEtlModels(ModelBuilder, EmptyContext), reproducing the pre-fix behaviour: a context scoped to tenant A can read tenant B's per-run lineage record (source kind, target table, column mappings, row counts) by id. Checked against EtlTenantIsolationTests.EtlLineageRecord_TenantA_CannotReadTenantB_Record, which seeds two EtlLineageRecord rows under two different tenants and asserts a context scoped to tenant A cannot resolve tenant B's row -- with the mutant applied, that read succeeds and the assertion fails. The green control, EtlLineageRecord_TenantA_CanReadOwnRecord, asserts tenant A can still read its OWN record, proving the mutation has no broader collateral effect on the EtlLineageRecords table registration.

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.EtlTenantIsolat: #862: a context scoped to tenant A must NOT resolve tenant B's EtlLineageRecord by GUID

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against the committed baseline (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first; mutant patch applied via git apply, test run, then reverted via git apply -R): 'Assert.IsNull failed. #862: a context scoped to tenant A must NOT resolve tenant B's EtlLineageRecord by GUID.' Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant etl862-applyetlmodels-lineagerecord-tenantfilter-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
